## Summary of meeting topics

- Scores and GEMS (Global Examination of Mental State) ability to identify pathologies
- Two types of cut-offs: Clinical (e.g. Crawford & Grathwaite, 1998, 2006) and ROC. Advantages, disadvantages, and does it make sense to have both?
- Correspondence between cognitive domains and tasks (i.e. on validity and measurement error).
